money_market.source: WIBOR fixings of 3 Mar 2026 (GPW Benchmark delayed data); repo from the Treasury BondSpot Poland session of 3 Mar 2026. Funding = nominal-weighted special repo starting within one day, <= 3 days (3.83%).

irs.source: PLN IRS vs 6M WIBOR at the 3 Mar 2026 close: LSEG end-of-day interbank bid rates in the Erste Bank Polska Codziennik of 4 Mar 2026 (table headed 03.03.2026; only the 3 Mar 2026 levels are used). Bid side, so roughly 1-2bp below mid. 7Y not available. PCHIP interpolation through 6M WIBOR and the pillars; beyond 10Y extrapolated.
irs.short_source: PLN IRS at the 3 Mar 2026 close (LSEG bid via Erste), WIBOR fixings 3 Mar 2026

curve.source: NSS zero curve fitted to BondSpot closing fixings of 3 Mar 2026; front end anchored at a 3M zero of 3.13% = average of sub-1Y fixed POLGB yields (DS0726 3.10%, PS1026 3.09%, OK0127 3.19%).

portfolio_meta._source: GPW Benchmark 'Portfele obligacji' communique for the periodic change of 27 Feb 2026 (holdings and statistics as of 24 Feb 2026; published 25 Feb 2026, PDF metadata 25 Feb). No membership changes; units updated for February supply (match MoF settlements to 20 Feb).
